body: [gendyn~] implements "Dynamic Stochastic Synthesis" based on Xenakis' 'GenDyn' algorithm. The waveform has a given number of points (linearly interpolated by default). The period of each point and its value changes according to a random walk (a.k.a. Brownian motion) with given distributions.
